DOUBLET FLOW: OUR THIRD ELEMENTARY FLOW

 There is a special, degenerate case of a source-sink pair that leads to a singularity called a
 doublet. The doublet is frequently used in the theory of incompressible flow; the purpose of this
 section is to describe its properties.
